features.title: Added feature / Notification of available update
features.description:
* Additional Feature / background update notifications 
You now can enable and define an automatic task to check and notify for available software update.
* how to use
Enable the background update notification in settings /  Startup & diagnostics section.
Define the desired delay you want to automatically be notified.
Activate notification for each software in your app list (bell icon)

features.title: 1.0.79 / Comparison & preview
features.description:
Version 1.0.79
Added new buttons to the Online Catalogue.
Compare
Highlights the differences between the online and local profiles. You can replace the local configuration with the online profile if desired.
See Profile
Shows a preview of the selected online profile's configuration.

fixes.title: Version 1.0.80 — Update progress now completes correctly for up-to-date software
fixes.description:
Fixed an issue where the update progress window could remain on **Step 1/6 — Checking update source** when trying to update software that was already up to date.

The progress now clearly reports that the software is already up to date and completes at 100%.
